skill.summary: Generate 30 fully produced, AI-powered short-form videos with viral hooks, captions, hashtags, and a 30-day posting calendar for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Instantly generate 30 AI-produced, viral-ready short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts in any niche.

- Scrapes and analyzes top 100 viral videos across platforms to identify trends and winning formats.
- Automates scriptwriting, hook/caption/hashtag generation, and AI-driven video production.
- Delivers a 30-day posting calendar with platform-optimized timing.
- Outputs ready-to-publish videos, scripts, captions, and hashtags — all exportable for immediate use.
- Powered by Apify for data extraction, InVideo AI for production, and Claude AI for creative scripting.
